svg.aria-label: Green-card grants to Hong Kong-born people
svg.title: Green-card grants to Hong Kong-born people
svg.desc: Resident stocks and status grants have distinct periods and populations; not all physical arrivals. USCIS suspended routine in-person services March 18, 2020; phased reopening began June 4, 2020. COVID-19 context is not a universal ban or an estimate of COVID's effect. Rules, exemptions and reopening dates varied by destination and category. U.S. fiscal years run October-September; Macau approvals use calendar years. In-country status adjustments are not border arrivals.

g.font-family: DejaVu Serif, Georgia, 'Times New Roman', serif
g.text: Green-card grants to Hong Kong-born people
DHS/OHSS birthplace category. Includes arrivals and adjustments, not just new departures from Hong Kong.
FY2015–2024 rounded to nearest ten. No visa or visitor counts substituted. COVID: in-person services
paused March 18-June 4, 2020; not a universal ban.
